what: A paper curtain (background color) covering the plate has rounded pill windows (superellipse n 2.8) cut in five rows. Rows 1·3·5 flow up and rows 2·4 flow down, staggered, one cell every 6s without a break. The store photo behind shows through the windows, and every third cell is an accent-color infinity (∞) knot pattern cell instead of a window. Wide screens use 307×434 with gaps 153/96 at a 1728 base, and 1024 and below use 115×162 with 32/32 at a 393 base, scaled in proportion to the plate width.

options.cols: Number of rows, default 5 — row width keeps the original ratio, so they gather in the center of the panel
options.dur: Duration of one cell flowing (s), default 6 (five cells in the original 30 seconds)
options.every: Every how many cells one becomes a pattern cell, default 3 — 0 means no pattern cells, all windows
options.n: Pill superellipse exponent, default 2.8 — 2 is an ellipse, larger is a rounder rectangle

use: Title

from.where: index.js .fv__window·.fv__window-pattern (Hero — original canvas destination-out pill windows in 5 columns, 5 cells per 30s)

note: The original uses two screen-fixed (position: fixed) canvases — the part attaches to the panel and draws at panel size. It pauses when the panel is offscreen. With reduced motion, it draws a single frame at the starting position
